## By leaps and bounds

**Word Power 45 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Very quickly; in large amounts.

### Usage

1. Her English has improved by leaps and bounds.
2. May your progress be by leaps and bounds!

### Your turn

Use “by leaps and bounds” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
